cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 70% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.51% · WTI +2.02% · Brent +1.57% · NatGas +1.58%. 70% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +1.83%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Power & IPPs lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.83%; weakest is Power & IPPs at +0.14%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: BE is the standout at +6.39%
cards.body: Leaders: BE +6.39%, MPC +2.39%, EQNR +2.31%, EOSE +2.27%, COP +2.26%. Laggards: SO -0.10%, D -0.06%.
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
